system.description:
Special Amp (Fortitude)

You are temporarily Transfigured, having your cells, organs and biological makeup slightly adjusted to better match one of the following designations chosen by the allied Medical-Nin that applied this effect.

Avian: You gain a flying speed equal to your movement speed, but must land at the end of your turn. You gain immunity to fall damage and cannot be knocked prone.

Carnivoran: You gain a bonus to your [Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] equal to the Medical-Nin's Channeled Healing bonus.

Herbivore: You gain DR equal to the Medical-Nin's Channeled Healing bonus.

Insectoid: You gain Darkvision and Chakra Sight out to 60ft and resistance to Chakra Damage.

Lasts 1 minute. Only one allied creature at a time.
system.summary: An ally's body takes a designation the Medical-Nin picks: Avian (fly), Carnivoran (+damage), Herbivore (DR), Insectoid (darkvision, chakra resistance).

rules.text: Pick the designation when applying: Avian (a flying speed equal to your speed, land at the end of your turn; immune to fall damage; can't be knocked prone), Carnivoran (+[Unarmed Damage] and [Weapon Damage] equal to the Medical-Nin's Channeled Healing bonus), Herbivore (DR equal to the Channeled Healing bonus), Insectoid (Darkvision and Chakra Sight 60 ft, resistance to chakra damage).
Only one ally at a time: transfiguring another ally ends the oldest. Chimeric designations (Aberration, Demonic, Monstrosity) at 10th and Sage Beast at 18th: see the Transmuter features.
